entries.en: The truth behind the mental shutdowns[n]remains unsolved though. Okumura[n]wasn't the culprit.

entries.en: I remember Father telling me something[n]before he changed...

entries.en: But no matter how much he begged my[n]grandfather, he never got it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Okumura Foods has been around for[n]generations, but it was a small company[n]until my father took over.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: My grandfather was a good man, but[n]not the best businessman. He'd even[n]lend money with no collateral...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It seems the debt collectors were a[n]frequent presence when my father[n]was young...

entries.en: That must be why...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Why Okumura was so willing to pursue[n]his own happiness at the expense of[n]others.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This thing's insane...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is a staggering price. I've heard this can[n]happen to collector's items, but still...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: People're gonna pay that much for[n]a plastic toy!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: By the way... when exactly is the change[n]of heart supposed to happen?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Soon. That's all we know.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We'll just have to wait and see what[n]happens until then.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Once he has his change of heart, we'll[n]surely be able to find out who's behind[n]the mental shutdowns.
